items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jack Yates was in that building. I think you did in Jack Yates's studio. Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Really? I don't know.

ctx.x: I'm not going to hear... We made some recording. We made some up there in the Gacho building there. Or I think it was the Gacho building. Yeah. Gacho building. Yeah. Gacho building. That's where it was. Gacho building. And then we went to Atlanta to make that other trip. And I think that's... With them, that's the only recording I made. Because I made some wood.
Jack Yates was in that building. I think you did in Jack Yates's studio. Yeah.
